# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>; master  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Phillips is sarcastic and often acts in a horrid manner toward his pupils. He is prone to spasmodic fits of reform and exhibits severe punishments, yet maintains little order in the classroom.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster in Avonlea. During his tenure, he regularly courted his student Prissy Andrews under the guise of helping her with her lessons, showing her special attention in and out of class. He enforced strict discipline inconsistently, such as calling out Anne Shirley for spelling mistakes, making her stand on the platform, and punishing students who returned late from recess. He once whipped Sam Boulter for being impudent, which caused Sam's father to confront him at school. He later gave a tearful farewell speech to his pupils at the end of his final term before leaving Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P59](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0059), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_
